ios.notes:
Poster: a photo of the artist fills Now Playing, a different one for each song.
Black and white with grain, or in colour, fading into the photo's own colour at the top and bottom.
Pick it in Customise, or the new Poster theme does it all in one tap.
Controls, in Customise: keep the heart and the play ring white, with the colour only in the background.

Duotone for iPhone 6.1.1

New
- Poster, in Customise → Artwork: a photo of the artist behind the top, the title and the controls. Each song gets its own photo while the artist has photos; without them, the artwork. The lyrics still turn in the square.
- Poster image: artist photos or the artwork. Black and white: the Poster with grain, like a printed photo.
- The Poster theme: artist photos in black and white, "Playing from", the ring play button and white controls in one tap.
- Controls, in Customise → Now Playing: Accent colour or White for the heart, the play ring, the dots, shuffle and repeat.

Improved
- The preview in Customise shows the progress bar in white, as in Now Playing.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.1.0...ios-v6.1.1

windows.notes:
Playlist folders: drag a playlist onto a folder to move it, or onto another playlist to make a folder or merge them.
The queue: shuffle what's next again, or select several songs with Ctrl or Shift+click to play next or remove, with Undo.
Radio never gives you the same queue twice for the same song.
Export your library and scrobble to ListenBrainz, both in Settings.

Duotone for Windows 6.1.0

New
- Playlist folders, in Playlists: drag a playlist onto a folder, or onto another playlist to make a folder or merge the two.
- Shuffle again and select several songs in the queue (Ctrl or Shift+click; Esc lets go).
- Share an album with a friend from the album's menu.
- Export your library in Settings: Liked Songs, playlists and albums, as JSON or CSV.
- ListenBrainz scrobbling in Settings: paste your token and your listens go straight from your PC. Private listening sends nothing.

Improved
- An artist's songs are in one list, in the order you choose.
- The update notice shows what's new instead of the version title.
- Fewer requests when Duotone opens.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v6.0.2...win-v6.1.0
